facts.text: In UCSB's College of Creative Studies, students choose one of nine majors when they apply, from art and biology to math, physics, and writing and literature.

sources.title: About | UCSB College of Creative Studies

facts.text: Students who live in residence halls for two years are guaranteed university apartment housing for their junior and senior years.

sources.title: Housing, Dining & Auxiliary Enterprises - UC Santa Barbara

facts.text: The Promise Scholar program awards $125,000 in grants and scholarships to first-year students over four years and $60,000 to transfer students over two years.

sources.title: About | Promise Scholars - UC Santa Barbara
